intent: The start-up script creates the dev database and starts the preview, but its tests use stand-in commands. Only a real restart and a fresh codespace show whether the preview comes up with races. This also settles whether the missing dev database was what left the preview empty before.
steps: Stop this codespace and start it again from GitHub
Wait for the start-up script to finish, then open the live preview
Create a brand-new codespace from main and open its live preview

surface.barrierDetail: Needs a real codespace stop/start and a fresh codespace build, which only GitHub Codespaces can do.
surface.note: Covers the codespace start-up script; no scenario can show a real restart.

title: The preview shows races after a codespace restart and in a brand-new codespace
